product.title: GATSBY Moving Rubber Wild Shake 80g
product.body_html:
Effortlessly Messy Style

Achieve a casual, messed-up look with GATSBY Moving Rubber Wild Shake. Made in Japan, this styling product helps you create dynamic movement and texture for an effortlessly cool hairstyle.

Key Features:

  • Casual Style: Formulated to create a casual, tousled look with ease.
  • Dynamic Movement: Provides flexibility and texture for hair that moves naturally.
  • Easy Application: Simply take a small quantity onto your palm, spread it out well, and blend into the ends or other parts of your hair for desired movement.

How to Use:

  1. Take a small quantity onto palm and spread out well.
  2. Blend into ends or other parts of hair where you want to create movement.
  3. Spread out thinly on the surface of hair by drawing round circles with palm.
  4. Split hair bundles around, pinching them lightly.

Ingredients:

  • Newly Developed Smooth Polymer
  • Euphorbia Cerifera (Candelilla) Wax
  • Microcrystalline Wax
